title: Certified Notarial Document Translation
description: Certified translations of notarial deeds, powers of attorney, and wills.

features.title: Public Deeds
features.description: Real estate sales, company formation, and mortgages.

faqs.question: Does the translation of a deed have validity in Germany?
faqs.answer: Specify the destination country, receiving organisation and intended use. The translation is prepared for the agreed assignment; the recipient determines the required documents, accepted formats and procedural requirements.

faqs.question: Do you translate powers of attorney for abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes, we translate powers of attorney for international use in both directions.

faqs.question: What documents for an international inheritance?
faqs.answer: The required documents depend on the transaction and countries involved. Ask the notary or professional handling the matter for a document checklist, then send those items for a translation quote. An apostille or legalisation should not be assumed necessary for every document.

faqs.question: How long for a sale deed?
faqs.answer: The delivery date is confirmed in the quote after reviewing the documents. State your deadline when sending the scan. Rush assignments depend on document length and availability.

faqs.question: Do you translate prenuptial agreements?
faqs.answer: Yes, we translate prenuptial agreements (capitulaciones matrimoniales in Spanish, Ehevertrag in German) which define the matrimonial property regime, especially important for Spanish-German couples.
